passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
passages.sermon:
God appeared to Ezekiel.
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel “son of man.”
God said, “Stand up on your feet.”
God said, “I will speak to you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ עֲמֹ֣ד עַל־ רַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַאֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֹתָֽךְ׃

passages.text: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
The Spirit entered me as He spoke.
The Spirit set me on my feet.
I heard Him speaking to me.
passages.original: וַתָּ֧בֹא בִ֣י ר֗וּחַ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י וַתַּעֲמִדֵ֖נִי עַל־ רַגְלָ֑י וָאֶשְׁמַ֕ע אֵ֖ת מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלָֽי׃פ

passages.text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to me.
He called me “son of man.”
God said, “I am sending you to the Israelites.”
The Israelites are a rebellious nation.
They have rebelled against Me.
Their fathers also rebelled against Me.
They have continued to rebel against Me until today.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ שׁוֹלֵ֨חַ אֲנִ֤י אֽוֹתְךָ֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם הַמּוֹרְדִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָרְדוּ־ בִ֑י הֵ֤מָּה וַאֲבוֹתָם֙ פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֔י עַד־ עֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are children.
They are obstinate.
They are stubborn.
God is sending you to these children.
You must go to them.
You must say to them, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
passages.original: וְהַבָּנִ֗ים קְשֵׁ֤י פָנִים֙ וְחִזְקֵי־ לֵ֔ב אֲנִ֛י שׁוֹלֵ֥חַ אוֹתְךָ֖ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃

passages.text: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are a rebellious people.
They may listen to you.
They may refuse to listen to you.
They belong to a rebellious house.
They will know this truth.
A prophet has been among them.
passages.original: וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ אִם־ יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְאִם־ יֶחְדָּ֔לוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵ֑מָּה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם׃פ

passages.text: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel, who was called "son of man."  
God told Ezekiel not to be afraid of the people.  
God told Ezekiel not to fear their words.  
The people were stubborn and rebellious.  
God said briers and thorns would surround Ezekiel.  
God said Ezekiel would live among scorpions.  
God told Ezekiel not to be afraid of their words.  
God told Ezekiel not to be discouraged by their presence.  
The people were a rebellious house.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָ֠דָם אַל־ תִּירָ֨א מֵהֶ֜ם וּמִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־ תִּירָ֗א כִּ֣י סָרָבִ֤ים וְסַלּוֹנִים֙ אוֹתָ֔ךְ וְאֶל־ עַקְרַבִּ֖ים אַתָּ֣ה יוֹשֵׁ֑ב מִדִּבְרֵיהֶ֤ם אַל־ תִּירָא֙ וּמִפְּנֵיהֶ֣ם אַל־ תֵּחָ֔ת כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel “son of man.”
God told Ezekiel to speak His words to the people of Israel.
The people of Israel are a rebellious house.
Ezekiel must speak God’s words to them.
Ezekiel must speak whether they listen or refuse to listen.
The people may not listen because they are rebellious.
passages.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֶת־ דְּבָרַי֙ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽם־ יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְאִם־ יֶחְדָּ֑לוּ כִּ֥י מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃פ

passages.text: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel, who was called "son of man."  
God told Ezekiel to listen to His words.  
God commanded Ezekiel not to be rebellious.  
God said the people of Israel were a rebellious house.  
God told Ezekiel not to act like them.  
God told Ezekiel to open his mouth.  
God told Ezekiel to eat what He gave him.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם שְׁמַע֙ אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ תְּהִי־ מֶ֖רִי כְּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי פְּצֵ֣ה פִ֔יךָ וֶאֱכֹ֕ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll, which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
passages.sermon:
I looked.
I saw a hand.
The hand reached out to me.
The hand held a scroll.
He unrolled the scroll in front of me.
The scroll had writing on the front.
The scroll had writing on the back.
The writing contained words of lamentation.
The writing contained words of mourning.
The writing contained words of woe.
passages.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּה־ יָ֖ד שְׁלוּחָ֣ה אֵלָ֑י וְהִנֵּה־ ב֖וֹ מְגִלַּת־ סֵֽפֶר׃ וַיִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אוֹתָהּ֙ לְפָנַ֔י וְהִ֥יא כְתוּבָ֖ה פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וְכָת֣וּב אֵלֶ֔יהָ קִנִ֥ים וָהֶ֖גֶה וָהִֽי׃ס
